name: comp-312
title: Version Update Banner
description: A slim centred bar showing a version number and release line beside an outlined Update now button, which becomes a spinner and Updating label while it pretends to work.
use: A new release is out and you want a low-key strip with one update action.
avoid: The download is simulated, so it only changes the button for two seconds and installs nothing.
a11y: Button text names the action and both icons are hidden, but the spinner keeps turning with no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-width muted grey band, a little lighter than the page, with its contents centred on one line. Small text reads v2.1.0, a dot, then a release note, followed by a small outlined Update now button with a download arrow.
behaves: Pressing Update now disables the button, swaps its label for Updating... and shows a spinning loader; after about two seconds it returns to normal.
customise: Version, message and button labels are hardcoded, and the download is a fixed two-second timeout.
weight: light: One thin bar; the only script work is a short timeout and a spinning icon.
